notes:
- Prestige: once you reach level 55, a PRESTIGE button appears on your level card. Your level goes back to 1
  and you climb the ranks again, but you keep everything you unlocked (guns, attachments, camos, looks, weapon
  levels, stats and challenges). You get a prestige badge next to your level (menu, co-op lobby, scoreboard, pause
  menu, over your head in co-op), up to Prestige 10, and the exclusive Prestige Crimson camo for every weapon.
  It's cosmetic only, so co-op stays fair.
- Rooms are furnished with sets that belong there, instead of random brick half-walls and crate stacks in the
  middle of the floor. Weight benches, pull-up bars and stacked mats in the gym; serving counters and bins in mess
  halls and cafeterias; IV stands and medicine cabinets on hospital wards; filing cabinets in offices; lockers in
  guard rooms; benches and trees in courtyards; tyres and tool chests in the auto shop, and so on. They stand
  against the walls facing in, clear of doors, windows and wall buys.
- Windows match their room: barred windows in the prison (the middle bars bent apart where something got
  through), white hospital windows with broken blinds, wooden house windows with shutters and a planter box,
  aluminium shop frames, hazard-striped lab frames, all with a proper sill.
- Boarded-up windows all look different: each window has its own board layout (level rows, a big X, or a
  messy job), boards of different lengths, widths and shades of wood, with nails.
- Fast Mag now unlocks before Extended Mag (gun level 3 and 10).
